title: Cosmic OS Working Philosophy
description: Canonical machine-readable schema for the Cosmic OS working philosophy. Optimizes HOW work is done: measure with discipline (frequency), balance trade-offs (polarity), time actions for leverage (resonance), respect maintenance cycles (rhythm), reuse motifs across scales (correspondence), defend structure against drift (negentropy) — all under deterministic, auditable, human-in-the-loop control.
invariants: Deterministic execution — Only explicit, versioned tuning JSON affects runtime behavior.
Fail-open — Optimization must never block business work; last-known or defaults always run.
Preview-first — Risky actions are preview → explain → apply, with STOP_WRITES available.
Idempotency required — Duplicate calls must not cause duplicate mutations.
Audit by default — Every apply and policy change is versioned with actor, reason, and diff.
Privacy first — No PCI; minimize/redact PII; least privilege on all services.

principles.rule: Treat cost/quality/latency as dials, not binaries
Fight drift with schemas, budgets, ownership
Don't automate what you can't see

antiPrinciples: No hidden auto-changes: AI cannot silently mutate runtime behavior.
No blocking on telemetry: ingest failures never fail business runs.
No partial schemas: every node must emit the uniform envelope.
No unbounded retries or parallelism: guard every loop.
prReviewChecklist: Does this change preserve deterministic execution via versioned tuning?
Is Explain() updated with rationale and expected impact?
Do new nodes emit the full envelope schema?
Are fail-open and rollback paths validated?
Is PII minimized/redacted in new logs/fields?
